Rule.name: Emergency Identity - Inactive Attribute
Rule.Description:
Global rule for the identity attribute "inactive" (the identity's disabled status in IIQ / LCM). Keeps it in step with the Emergency Disable flag:
emergencyDisable = true -> inactive = true otherwise -> inactive from the HR Authoritative CSV account (true for PreHire and Terminated)
Replaces the plain HR mapping of "inactive", so an identity refresh never re-activates an identity that an administrator disabled in an emergency. Set up by the rule "Emergency Identity - Setup".
